INTERIOR DESIGN SERVICE AGREEMENT



Thanks for choosing Established Design Co..  We are excited to help you in creating a beautiful space within your home. We hope that this Interior Design Service Agreement (the “Agreement”) and the attached Scope of Work provided (the “SOW”) will help answer any questions you may have about our services and clarify the nature and expectations of our professional relationship. This Agreement is effective once both parties have executed it and will remain in effect until all services are fully completed, until the conclusion of the contract or until otherwise terminated per this Agreement (the “Term”). If you are a recurring client, your execution of this Agreement demonstrates your understanding that this Agreement will apply to all future services outlined in any SOW sent by us (unless a subsequent service agreement is executed). Any proposal or document provided to you prior to the execution of this Agreement is intended for informative purposes only, and in the event of a conflict, this Agreement will prevail.


  1. SERVICES: We provide interior design services. Our services may include the following:
  2. Developing interior design plans, mood boards, sketches, notes, floor plans, elevations, color palettes, finish specifications, and interior furnishing specifications (collectively the “Design Plans”), which may include fabrics/textiles, upholstery, flooring, shelving, architectural treatments, accessories, appliances, build materials, lighting, artwork, plants, furniture, and other decorative, furnishing and material choices for your Design Space (collectively the “Interior Items/Furnishings”).
  3. Interior Items/Furnishings per room budget allocation.
  4. Ordering of physical samples of Interior Items/Furnishings.
  5. Presentation of Design Plans and other information relevant to your Design Space.
  6. Procurement, storage, and delivery logistics of the Interior Items/Furnishings.
  7. Installation and styling or management of the installation and styling of the Interior Items/Furnishings.
  8. Meetings and site visits with you and Contractors. 
  9. Serving in a general advisory and liaison role between you and/or Contractors to implement design conformity to a remodel, construction, or new build project. For full service clients only.
  10. Punch List walkthrough with Contractors.


  1. CHANGE IN SERVICES: We understand that, at times, changes may need to be made to the scope of Services initially agreed on. If you decide that you would like to change or extend the Services stated in the SOW, we request that you provide us written notice outlining the proposed changes. We do not allow for decreases in Services after the execution of this SOW. Sometimes we may have to decline the proposed changes, and we reserve the right to do so. Any acceptance of proposed changes may be subject to fee increases, additional upfront payment of fees, and extension of the Delivery Estimates (as defined below). All changes and additional services will be subject to this Agreement and any additional SOW executed.


  1. SERVICE FEES: The specific fees for your project are stated in the SOW (the “Service Fees”) and are due in accordance with the payment schedule stated in the SOW (the “Payment Schedule”). A non-refundable $10,000 deposit will be due before we start Services. This deposit secures your project on our schedule and allows us to begin initial design work, including concept development, sourcing, and client onboarding. If Services go beyond the scope of Services listed in the SOW, we will charge our hourly rate as stated in the SOW (the “Hourly Rate”), which is $250 per hour, to be billed in 60-minute increments. This hourly design fee applies to all additional work not included in the initial Scope of Work. All Service Fees made are non-refundable upon payment.



  1. EXPENSES & SALES TAX: You will be responsible for all expenses incurred by us while performing Services, and such expenses may include samples, postage, and handling, receiver costs, Interior Items/Furnishings, freight, printing, sub-contractors, shipping, long-distance calls, delivery, duties, storage, parking, payment transaction fees, other incidentals and pre-approved travel costs such as transportation, meals, and lodging (the “Expenses”). Expenses will be billed as incurred and are due within 14 calendar days of the sent date on the invoice sent by us, except for Interior Item/Furnishing expenses which must be paid in advance of us ordering or purchasing any Interior Items/Furnishings on your behalf. You understand that Interior/Items and Services rendered by us may be subject to sales tax, and you agree to pay all such taxes and understand that while we make best efforts to include anticipated taxes on quotes and estimates given, such taxes are often unknown and may only be contained on a final invoice.


  1. BUDGET & FEE ESTIMATES: We may work with you to develop a budget for your Design Space (the “Budget”), and at times we may provide estimates to you while rendering Services (the “Estimated Fees”). While we always try to provide accurate Estimated Fees and keep within your Budget, sometimes unanticipated circumstances increase the amount of fees initially estimated. We will let you know when we foresee an increase in the Estimated Fee or the Budget, at which point we will issue a new Estimated Fee and update the Budget. These terms include Interior Furnishings and Construction/Renovation Estimates. You understand that Estimated Fees given for Interior Items/Furnishings are subject to change and may not reflect the final costs of Interior Items/Furnishings due to additional fees (e.g., sales tax, storage, shipping, delivery, ancillary items, and accessories), which are often not known until the Interior Items/Furnishings have been purchased. You agree to these additional fees being billed even if they were not contained on an original quote.


  1. PAYMENT METHOD: All payments for Service Fees and Expenses are preferred to be made by Check or Bank Transfer, and you will be required to pay any returned payment fees. Alternative payment methods such as credit card payment will include a 3% processing fee. Any bank fees associated with transfer processing will be billed to you.


  1. OVERDUE PAYMENTS: We may suspend all performance of Services and withhold delivery of Interior Items/Furnishings, without liability, if payments are overdue. If payment has not been made in accordance with the Payment Schedule for more than 7 days, we reserve the right to charge a pro-rated late fee equal to 10 percent of the overdue amount per week, plus interest charged on the unpaid amount per the maximum rate legally allowed. If an invoice is overdue by more than 30 calendar days, we reserve the right to terminate all Services immediately as a breach of this Agreement by you per the Termination provisions of this Agreement and refer any further collection of the outstanding unpaid amount, plus any late fees, termination fees, and interest due, to an attorney or collections agency. You will be liable for all attorney fees, court costs, or collection agency fees incurred due to late payment.


  1. FEE DISPUTES: If you have concerns about an invoice or wish to dispute a fee contained in an invoice, you must do so within 7 calendar days of receipt of the invoice sent by us. Any charges not disputed within 7 calendar days will be deemed accepted by you. We both agree to work in good faith to timely resolve any disputed fees.


  1. DELIVERY ESTIMATES: Although we work hard to meet your project timeline goals, unexpected delays may occur, and such delays will not be deemed a breach of this Agreement. A general estimated timeline for Services is provided in the SOW, and other timelines may be provided while Services are rendered (the “Delivery Estimates”). All delivery timelines for Interior Items/Furnishings and Contractors are out of our control.


  1. DESIGN PLANS: Any Design Plans and/or other design materials provided by us to show the suggested interior design concept are purely conceptual and are intended to set forth design and material intent only. We are not an architecture or engineering firm. Our Services do not include guarantees regarding modifications to structural, mechanical, or electrical components of your space. We will not be liable for the external use of the Design Plans for such modifications.


  1. APPROVALS, REVISIONS & INFORMATION: While rendering the Services, we may request for approvals, revisions, or information to be provided to us. We request that you return all approvals, revisions, and information to us within 24 hours to not cause delays. Please note that at times we may need a quicker turnaround on approvals, revisions, and information, and you agree to comply with such requirements as they are communicated to you. Prompt approval and payment for final sale, auction, custom, one-of-a-kind, and vintage Interior Items/Furnishings are highly recommended to increase the chances of securing such Interior Items/Furnishings. We will not be responsible for any fees resulting from a change of mind or incorrect information provided by you. In this event, we will charge additional hourly fees for any work performed thereafter.


  1. PROCUREMENT OF INTERIOR ITEMS/FURNISHINGS & PRICING: If you have Interior Items/Furnishings that you already own and would like to incorporate into your Design Space, please let us know in advance so that we can consider such items when creating the Design Plans. We retain the option to decide against incorporating any previously owned furnishings or furnishings purchased during the project. We cannot guarantee prices or availability of Interior Items/Furnishings, and prices and stock are subject to change before the ordering is processed. If at the time of ordering any Interior Item/Furnishing over $2,000.00 has increased in price by more than 5% or is unavailable, we will request your pre-approval and identify comparable alternative items as needed. We do not allow clients to procure Interior Items/Furnishings individually. Should you purchase any Interior Items/Furnishings without our approval, you will be solely responsible for such Interior Items/Furnishings, including their installation. Under no circumstances will we be required to share the sourcing of Interior Items/Furnishings with you before the installation is complete. While we aim to work within your Interior Item/Furnishing Budget, we cannot guarantee the lowest prices and are not obligated to research lower prices, price match sales, markdowns, or discounts available elsewhere. We may at times receive trade discounts, and it is fully within our discretion as to whether we use, or pass on, any such discounts to you. All fees for Interior Items/Furnishings must be made before purchase, and if Interior Items/Furnishings are purchased by us on your behalf before payment (as may be the case with vintage, final sale, and auction items), payment of such Interior Items/Furnishings will be added to your next monthly invoice. 


  1. RECEIVING AND STORAGE: We coordinate logistics and delivery of all Interior Items/Furnishings ordered. At our full discretion, Interior Items/Furnishings may be sent to a receiver for inspection, cataloging, and safe storage until they are ready for installation, sent directly to the Design Space, or sent to our offices. If a receiver is needed, we will determine the appropriate receiver based on your location and communicate the estimated costs associated with the receiver once they have been secured. While delivery couriers and receivers we use typically carry insurance, you may, at your own expense, choose to further insure Interior Items/Furnishings while in transit and storage, as we will not be liable for any damages that occur while Interior Items/Furnishings are in transit or being stored. Receiving and storage is not included in our estimate and will be billed accordingly monthly.


  1. INSTALLATION: All In-House or Third-Party Contractor services must be fully completed before installation of Interior Items/Furnishings occurs, and only our staff are permitted to be present in the Design Space during installation. The installation of Interior Items/Furnishings will occur on set day(s) as determined at our sole discretion. Under no circumstances will we provide installation over holidays or scheduled out-of-office hours.


  1. REFUNDS & EXCHANGES: Final sale, auction, custom, one-of-a-kind, and vintage Interior Items/Furnishings cannot be refunded or exchanged, so please ensure such items are chosen carefully. All other Interior Items/Furnishings are subject to the refund and exchange policies of the product vendor. Once delivered, it may not be possible to refund or exchange Interior Items/Furnishings, and refunds or exchanges may be subject to a restocking fee; as such, all refunds and exchanges are assessed on an individual basis, and you must make such requests within 24 hours of delivery or installation (whichever occurs first) of the Interior Items/Furnishings to the Design Space. All refunds and exchanges must be unused, undamaged, and in their original package, and if the original packaging is not suitable or available, you will be responsible for the costs of replacement packaging. If a product vendor allows for a refund, we will refund you within 60 calendar days of receiving the refund, or with your permission, we will put the amount towards other Interior Items/Furnishings or Services. If the above reporting requirements have not been complied with, or you or a Third-Party Contractor directly purchased the Interior Item/Furnishing, it will be your sole responsibility to coordinate any necessary actions regarding the refund or exchange of Interior Items/Furnishings directly with the product vendor.


  1. DAMAGED OR DEFECTIVE INTERIOR ITEMS/FURNISHINGS: We will either have staff or the third-party receiving warehouse inspect all Interior Items/Furnishings delivered to the receiving warehouse or office as they arrive and make all reasonable efforts to fix, refund, or exchange any damaged or defective Interior Item/Furnishing. It is your responsibility to inspect the Interior Items/Furnishings and report any damages or defects to us within 24 hours of delivery or installation (whichever occurs first) of the Interior Items/Furnishings to the Design Space. Provided that reports have been made in compliance with the above, we will make all reasonable efforts to have the damaged or defective Interior Items/Furnishings repaired, refunded, or exchanged. If the above reporting requirements have not been complied with, or you or a Third-Party Contractor directly purchased the Interior Items/Furnishings, it will be your sole responsibility to coordinate any necessary actions regarding damaged or defective Interior Items/Furnishings directly with the product vendor. Please note that vintage or auction Interior Items/Furnishings may have dents or blemishes that add to their charm and that such characteristics will not be considered a damage or defect. 


  1. ACCESS & PREPARATION: You agree to allow us to access the Design Space and any necessary surrounding property during reasonable hours with or without your presence during the Term, as needed and mutually arranged. Please ensure that we have easy access to the Design Space and that the Design Space is clean, and current Interior Items/Furnishings are removed as necessary. If the Design Space has not been prepared accordingly for Services, Services may be delayed until you have ensured that the Design Space is ready. We cannot be responsible for the supervision of pets, and it is your sole responsibility to ensure that all pets are in a secure location or are removed from the Design Space while Services are rendered. You and/or any Third-Party Contractor will be solely responsible for ensuring that the Design Space and any surrounding property is safe while Services are rendered. 


  1. INSURANCE & PERMITS: You are required to have the property in which the Design Space is located and all personal property adequately insured throughout the Term of this Agreement and to obtain all necessary permits and/or city approvals for the project. We reserve the right to request proof of such insurance policies and permits but will not be liable for ensuring that such insurance policies and permits have been acquired before rendering Services. 


  1. THIRD-PARTY CONTRACTORS: It is your responsibility to ensure that all Third-Party Contractors are paid on time, have necessary licenses, carry insurance, and that you understand any third-party contract provided to you. Under no circumstances will we be liable for services carried or not carried out by Third-Party Contractors involved in the project, and we make no warranties concerning the services carried out by Third-Party Contractors, whether or not we have recommended such parties. You are solely responsible for providing and coordinating any necessary documentation requested by Third Party Contractors. If we have agreed to work with your Third-Party Contractors in a design conformity liaison role, we request that you do not interfere or direct Third-Party Contractors working on the design aspect of the building project and that any communications or concerns regarding the design elements of such Third-Party Contractor’s services are directly brought to us.


  1. SUBCONTRACTORS: At times, your project may require additional third-party trades unrelated to the structural modifications of your Design Space, such as wallpaper installers, custom furniture designers, movers, and art installers. Where appropriate (and at our full discretion), we will give you an estimate of anticipated costs and subcontract such third parties directly. You will be required to make all payments for construction/renovating separate from our design service agreement. 


  1. MAINTENANCE OF INTERIOR ITEMS/FURNISHINGS: It is your sole responsibility to ensure all Interior Items/Furnishings are maintained per their specific requirements. We will use reasonable efforts to inform you of any special maintenance requirements but will not be responsible for damages, defects, or the death of plants caused by poor maintenance. As with any product, all Interior Items/Furnishings will, over time, be subject to general wear, tear, deterioration, and fading. 


  1. CREATIVE DISCRETION: You understand and agree that our Services are creative in nature and that creative-based work is inherently subjective. You acknowledge that although we aim to meet your vision, goal, and purpose in the Services we provide, we require and retain some degree of discretion regarding how Services are provided. You agree that you are familiar with our portfolio and are requesting Services with knowledge of the nature of our work, but with the understanding that our work is continually evolving and that we focus on meeting your particular Design Space needs based on our experience and your preferences communicated to us. Mere dissatisfaction in the creative elements or design of the Services will not be deemed a breach of this Agreement by us. Please remember that you are hiring us for our skills and knowledge, and we ask that you trust the process.


General timeline on processes


  1. MEETINGS & SITE VISITS: We may require several meetings and/or site visits and may need you or certain Third-Party Contractors to be available for such meetings and/or site visits. We will give you advanced notice of when meetings and site visits are anticipated to occur and strive to come to a date, time, and type (in-person, video conference, or phone) agreeable between both of us, as well as any Third-Party Contractor. If you need to reschedule a meeting, please aim to give at 24 hours’ notice when possible.


  1. BUSINESS HOURS: Our business hours are Monday-Friday 9am-5pm. We request all Service-related messages to be sent via email and for all phone calls, meetings, and site visits to be scheduled in advance to ensure availability. Texts are reserved for quick updates (e.g., a meeting running late) and should not be used to communicate regularly with us. Please allow at least 24 hours for our response. There may be periods where we may be delayed in responding, and we will use our best efforts to notify you of any such scheduled delay. 


  1. PROMPT COMMUNICATIONS: It is important that you communicate efficiently with us, and any delay from you in providing approvals, revisions, or information may result in the delay of the Delivery Estimates. If we have not received a required responsive communication from you for a period exceeding 3 calendar days, we reserve the right to delay the delivery of our Services to you to the degree necessary to allow us to manage other business schedules. Delays in communication from the client that cause an extension beyond the contractual end date will not be attributed to our responsibility or liability. If we have not received a required responsive communication from you for a period exceeding 30 calendar days, we reserve the right to terminate all Services immediately as a breach of this Agreement by you per the Termination provisions of this Agreement. If you require responses from us or wish to schedule a meeting, we request notification at least one week in advance. We may not always be able to accommodate requests made the week of, unless they pertain to urgent matters.


  1. APPROPRIATE CONDUCT & ENVIRONMENT: While in minor instances we may attempt to notify you and resolve the issue if we feel as though your conduct is inappropriate or we are faced with an unsafe or unsanitary working environment, we reserve the right to terminate all Services immediately as a breach of this Agreement by you per the Termination provisions of this Agreement, if, in our discretion, we determine that we have suffered harassment, bullying, inappropriate behavior, or discrimination from you or any other individual under your control or we are faced with a working environment that is unsafe or unsanitary. We reserve the right to compile documentation of such conduct.


  1. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY: We retain all intellectual property and proprietary rights including, but not limited to, copyrights, patents, moral rights, and trademarks, interest, and title in and to all Design Plans, custom furniture designs, and materials created in rendering the Services, whether they be preliminary or final designs. If we provide a copy of such intellectual property to you, we grant to you a limited non-transferable license for the sole purpose of allowing you to review and implement the designs of the intellectual property and do not under any circumstances transfer any intellectual property rights to you or license the intellectual property for any further purposes. For purposes of clarity, you are not permitted to display the intellectual property on any online platform, make copies of the intellectual property, use the intellectual property for any project not involving us (including if this Agreement has been Terminated), distribute the intellectual property to third parties or use the intellectual property for any commercial use such as advertising or marketing, without our express written permission. However, you and third parties involved in the project are permitted to share photos and videos of the Design Space, provided that we are appropriately credited as the designer, and nothing in this Section should be construed to limit your reasonable use and alienability of the finished design project. We request that you tag our social media accounts for all social media posts of the Design Space.


  1. PUBLICITY: You grant us permission to photograph and video the Design Space at our own expense while rendering Services, including a professional photography and/or videography shoot at the end of the project's completion (in our full discretion and to be scheduled for a mutually agreed upon date and time). You grant to us a perpetual, universal, irrevocable license to use such photographs and videos of the Design Space for promotional and business marketing purposes, including but not limited to use in portfolios, publications, social media, advertisements, competitions, and presentations via newspaper, internet or any other media source now existing or developed in the future. We agree not to use any personally identifiable information such as your name or address in our marketing and promotions without your written permission. You permit us to place a lawn or fence sign on the property in which the Design Space is located throughout the Term of this Agreement (provided we comply with HOA requirements).


  1. NON-SOLICITATION & NON-DISPARAGEMENT: You agree not to solicit partners, agents, employees, or contractors utilized by us for a period of one (1) year after the expiration or termination of this Agreement without our express written permission. You agree to take no action, both during and after the Term of this Agreement, which is intended or would reasonably be expected to harm our reputation or which would reasonably be expected to lead to unwanted or unfavorable publicity to us. If you have any concerns or complaints regarding our Services, we encourage you to reach out to us directly via e-mail or phone call so that we can discuss such issues.


  1. TERMINATION & POSTPONEMENT: This Agreement may be voluntarily terminated or postponed, in whole or in part, at any time by either party per the following provisions:


  1. Breach & Opportunity to Fix Issues: Except as otherwise stated in this Agreement, if either party is terminating this Agreement for an alleged breach of this Agreement, the terminating party agrees to notify the non-terminating party in writing and give at least 14 calendar days from the date of the notification to fix the issue or alleged breach. If the issue or the alleged breach are not cured within the allotted time above, the party may terminate this Agreement in accordance with the terms below. 


++++


  1. Termination By or Due to You: You may voluntarily terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, by giving at least 30 calendar days’ written notice of the intention to terminate. If you wish to terminate this Agreement, or you have breached this Agreement, the following will occur upon termination, not as a penalty, but as reasonable compensation for our loss of business: 


  1. we will retain all paid Service Fees which, as stated above, are non-refundable upon payment by you;
  2. you will be required to pay all outstanding payment of Service Fees and Design and/or Construction Expenses incurred through to the date of termination;
  3. you will be required to pay a termination fee of 15% of the remaining payment obligation based on the total estimated Service Fees provided in the SOW, or as such total estimated Service Fee may be amended, as compensation for our loss of business; and
  4. we may be entitled to further remedies and compensation under the law if you breached this Agreement.


Outstanding charges will be invoiced accordingly and due upon the receipt of the invoice sent by us (subject to the Overdue Payments section.)


  1. Termination by Us: We may voluntarily terminate this Agreement at any time. If we terminate this Agreement due to no breach or fault by you, we will retain all earned fees for Services (charged at our Hourly Rate stated in the SOW) and will be entitled to all outstanding reimbursement of Service Fees incurred through to the date of termination. All payments due under this Section are to be made upon receipt of the invoice and subject to the Overdue Payments section of this Agreement. Outstanding charges will be invoiced accordingly and due upon receipt (subject to the Overdue Payments section.) If we terminate this Agreement due to your breach of this Agreement, the above terms stated in sub-section (b) of this Section will apply.


  1. REPRESENTATIONS & WARRANTIES: YOU HAVE THE BENEFIT OF ALL GUARANTEES AND WARRANTIES PROVIDED BY SUPPLIERS OF INTERIOR ITEMS/FURNISHINGS. HOWEVER, WE, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY THE LAW OF THE JURISDICTION, EXPRESSLY DISCLAIM ANY AND ALL WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND OR NATURE, WHETHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, WORKMANSHIP, AND FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. WE MAKE NO WARRANTIES REGARDING ANY SERVICES PROVIDED BY THIRD PARTIES INVOLVED IN THE PROJECT, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO GENERAL CONTRACTORS, ENGINEERS, AND ARCHITECTS.


  1. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY: TO THE FULLEST EXTENT THE LAW OF THE JURISDICTION PERMITS, WE WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY LOSS OF USE, INTERRUPTION OF BUSINESS, INJURY, DEATH, LOSS OR DAMAGE OF PROPERTY, LOST PROFITS, OR ANY INDIRECT, SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES OF ANY KIND WHETHER RESULTING FROM A FORM OF ACTION UNDER CONTRACT, TORT, STRICT PRODUCT LIABILITY OR OTHERWISE. WE WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY THIRD-PARTY USED TO FULFILL OUTSIDE SERVICES RELATED TO SERVICES PROVIDED UNDER THIS AGREEMENT OR OTHERWISE, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO, SOFTWARE PROVIDERS, GENERAL CONTRACTORS, ENGINEERS, AND ARCHITECTS. OUR SERVICES ARE SOLD “AS IS,” AND IN NO EVENT WILL OUR AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT.


  1. INDEMNIFICATION: You agree to indemnify and hold us, and our owners, employees, successors, assignees, agents, and contractors, harmless from any and all claims, losses, liability, damages, expenses, and costs (including reasonable attorney fees and court costs) arising from your breach of this Agreement, any act of any Third-Party Contractor including any use of hazardous materials, or any injury or damage caused by or arising out of the Services that are not a result of our wilful negligence.


  1. CONFIDENTIALITY: Both parties agree not to, without the prior written consent of the other party, disclose to any third person or entity, other than in the proper course of performance under this Agreement, any information that under the circumstances ought to be reasonably treated as confidential or proprietary. Confidential or proprietary information includes, but is not limited to, personal information, business plans and strategies, trade secrets, legal documents including this Agreement and fees charged under this Agreement, customer, contractor and vendor information, design proposals, future and proposed products, marketing plans, processes, operations, and other business, personal, financial, or technical information.  


  1. DISPUTE RESOLUTION & PREVAILING PARTY: If a dispute arises out of or relating to this Agreement that cannot be amicably resolved, the parties agree to attempt to settle the dispute with the help of a mutually agreed-upon HALL COUNTY, GA mediator, unless mediation is otherwise mutually waived, or the dispute falls into the jurisdiction of HALL COUNTY, GA Small Claims Court and as such would be more efficiently and cost-effectively resolved in a HALL COUNTY, GA Small Claims Court. A prevailing party in a dispute will have the right to collect from the other party its reasonable costs and necessary disbursements and reasonable attorneys' fees incurred in enforcing this Agreement.


MISCELLANEOUS: (a) Neither party will be considered in breach of this Agreement if either party’s performance of this contract (excluding payment obligations) is delayed or prevented by a Force Majeure Event. A “Force Majeure Event” is an event or series of related events that are outside the reasonable control of the party affected, including but not limited to, acts of God, power failures, government shutdowns, disasters, fires, floods, riots, trade strikes, epidemics, pandemics, terrorist attacks, and wars. The affected party must give reasonable notice upon becoming aware that an event may affect this Agreement and make all reasonable efforts to continue performance despite the Force Majeure Event. All non-refundable payments are non-refundable upon receipt, even if a Force Majeure Event occurs. (b) The relationship between the parties is that of independent contractors.
